finding: Gemma allocator requested 9.48 GiB with only 9.27 GiB free while idle Nemotron ASR and other workers were resident.
fix: Nemotron loads on demand; a large planner can evict idle ASR, and ASR can evict an idle planner under memory pressure.

finding: Qwen3-ASR shared the speech-model replacement lock and returned HTTP 429 during Omni inference.
fix: Dedicated GPU2 ASR workers on loopback 9116/9117, independent queues; voice model remains loaded.

timingExclusion.reason: client suspended during maintenance; quality result kept, latency excluded

latencyCaveat: Remaining Omni rows share GPU2 with resident ASR workers; this is not an exclusive-GPU latency benchmark.
